title: Ale for the Wedding
offer: I am marrying Bjarne the boatwright in two days! But the wedding ale is still at Knut the brewer's in Lindtorp. Three barrels: will they fit in your boat?

steps.load_say: The wedding ale for Astrid! Row smoothly, girls, and do not taste it on the way.

steps.say: All three barrels! Now the wedding can be merry. You are invited, of course!

fact: A viking wedding lasted for days, and the guests drank a special bridal ale.
